name: Client
description: The end user's device that originates every request. All data flows begin here.

name: DNS
description: Resolves human-readable domain names to server IP addresses so clients can find your services.

name: CDN
description: Caches static assets at edge locations near users, cutting latency and offloading origin servers.

name: Load Balancer
description: Distributes incoming traffic across a pool of servers, enabling horizontal scale and failover.

name: API Gateway
description: Single entry point for APIs that handles routing, auth, throttling, and request shaping.

name: Rate Limiter
description: Caps how many requests a client can make in a window to protect downstream services from abuse.

name: Reverse Proxy
description: Terminates connections, serves TLS, and forwards requests to backend servers.

name: Prompt Router
description: Routes AI prompts to the right model or provider based on cost, latency, or capability.

name: Web Application Firewall
description: Filters and blocks malicious HTTP traffic (injection, bots) before it reaches your application.

name: Web Server
description: Stateless application server that handles HTTP requests and runs business logic.

name: WebSocket Server
description: Maintains long-lived bidirectional connections for real-time push to clients.

name: Worker
description: Background process that consumes jobs from a queue and performs asynchronous work.

name: Stream Processor
description: Processes unbounded event streams in near real time for aggregation and enrichment.

name: Task Scheduler
description: Triggers jobs on a schedule or dependency graph for periodic and batch workloads.

name: Embedding Service
description: Converts text or media into dense vectors for semantic search and retrieval.

name: LLM Inference
description: Serves large-language-model generations. GPU-heavy and the dominant cost/latency in AI systems.

name: Chunking Service
description: Splits documents into overlapping chunks sized for embedding and retrieval.

name: Reranker
description: Reorders retrieved candidates by relevance to sharpen results before they hit the LLM.

name: SQL Database
description: Relational store with ACID transactions and joins for structured, consistent data.

name: NoSQL Database
description: Horizontally scalable wide-column store for high write throughput and flexible schemas.

name: Blob Storage
description: Durable, cheap object storage for large unstructured files like images and video.

name: Search Index
description: Inverted-index engine for full-text search, faceting, and relevance ranking.

name: Time-Series DB
description: Optimized for append-heavy timestamped metrics and fast range queries.

name: Graph Database
description: Stores nodes and relationships for traversals like social graphs and recommendations.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Columnar analytics store for large-scale OLAP queries and reporting over historical data.

name: Vector Database
description: Indexes embeddings for approximate nearest-neighbor semantic search in RAG pipelines.

name: Context Store
description: Holds conversation history and session context for stateful AI and chat applications.

name: Cache
description: In-memory key-value store that serves hot reads in microseconds and shields the database.

name: Bloom Filter
description: Probabilistic membership test that avoids expensive lookups for keys that don't exist.

name: Message Queue
description: Durable buffer that decouples producers from consumers and absorbs traffic spikes.

name: Pub/Sub
description: Fan-out messaging that broadcasts an event to many independent subscribers.

name: Dead Letter Queue
description: Captures messages that repeatedly fail processing so they can be inspected and replayed.

name: Notification Service
description: Delivers push, SMS, and email notifications to users across channels.

name: Payment Service
description: Handles charges, subscriptions, and payouts via a third-party payment provider.

name: ZooKeeper / etcd
description: Distributed coordination store for leader election, config, and cluster membership.

name: Monitoring & Alerting
description: Collects metrics, visualizes dashboards, and fires alerts when systems misbehave.

name: Service Registry
description: Tracks healthy service instances so callers can discover and route to them dynamically.

name: Circuit Breaker
description: Stops calling a failing dependency to prevent cascading failures and give it time to recover.

name: Log Aggregator
description: Centralizes logs from every service for search, correlation, and debugging.

name: Guardrail Service
description: Screens LLM inputs and outputs for unsafe, off-policy, or injected content.

name: LLM Observability
description: Traces prompts, tokens, cost, and quality across AI pipelines for debugging and evaluation.

name: Model Registry
description: Versions, stages, and serves ML models so deployments are reproducible and auditable.
